fact: A 92 billion FCFA, three-year DIGI-CoR programme to digitalise Cameroon's 384 local authorities was presented on 2 June 2026, with Simba to be made interoperable and 68.5% of CTDs lacking structured computer networks.
title: Cameroun - Financement du Projet DIGI-CoR : L'État recherche 92 milliards FCFA
